## Changes

- Prepare forks and rollbacks as drafts, creating the new thread only when the first message is sent. When replacing a thread, archive the source only after that message is accepted, and leave it unarchived if it has changed.
- Return to the source thread from an unsent fork or rollback using a new composer button, with confirmation before discarding edited text or attachments.
- Keep hooks and archived threads available for retry after a failed settings action, and show the reason for the failure.
- Restore settings controls to their saved values when a preference change fails to save.
